Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://docs.docker.com/guides/testcontainers-java-replace-h2/junit-extension-approach

Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for Dockerfile/compose/build/MCP/sandbox docs: junit extension approach

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:

Rules:
